Author: Alex Vallière
Name: Submarine ETA Planner
Punchline: Plan and monitor your Free Company submarine fleets.
Description: Plan Free Company submarine operations from local SubmarineTracker data: choose which tracked FCs to show, prioritize returns and next actions, forecast leveling and sector unlocks, review recorded salvage income and project future farming earnings, track locally observed character wallets and FC chest gil, configure farming routes, and estimate ceruleum fuel runway. Requires Submarine Tracker to be installed and enabled. Open it with /seta. The installer icon was created with AI assistance.
Changelog: Version 1.2.3 fixes character wallets remaining unassigned when the game provides an FC ID but no FC name. The next valid home-world observation repairs the association automatically. Existing world, character-tag, and FC-ID checks remain in place; saved balances and diagnostic support are preserved.
